name: Sylvan-Catafalque

civilization.name: Ysolde Dominion
civilization.notes: Descendants of a crashed generation ship, their iron-age rites center the hull that never flew again.

description: Water rules this world utterly, kilometers deep over drowned continents. Swells march in orderly regiments until they shatter against towering mountain ranges, and the spray smells of minerals and cold salt.
The silence has texture, close to audible. Old survey teams left notes about hearing their own heartbeats as knocking. Their beacons answer incoming ships in a hundred borrowed languages.
Debris from the escape pod debris field rings the crash basin in a perfect fan, which ballistics cannot explain. Survivors' accounts disagree about the last hour completely.

For traders, fusion fuel, water, rare flora and biomass alone justifies the crossing; for everyone else, the planet pays in questions. Fuel is cheap, information is not, and both are dangerous to carry.
